147-1070-8095.easyPrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard.
147-1070-8095.description:
Cast Rise Again by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Rise Again.
Holding priority, activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage, putting a +1/+1 counter on Hammerhead.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Rise Again
Resolve the Rise Again copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

147-3967-4454.easyPrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard.
147-3967-4454.description:
Cast Bond of Revival by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Bond of Revival.
Holding priority, activate Yahenni by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage, Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Bond of Revival
Resolve the Bond of Revival copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

1479-2841-3875-8102.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Windswept Heath.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
1479-2841-3875-8102.description:
Fetch a land using Windswept Heath.
When the fetched land enters, Tireless Provisioner and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Tireless Provisioner trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Tireless Provisioner from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Tireless Provisioner triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

967-3809-7087-7824-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Flameskull.
When Flameskull dies, it triggers, exiling it and the top card of your library with the ability to cast one from exile this turn.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Cast Flameskull from exile by paying {1}{R}{R}.
Prosper's second ability triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{R}{R}.
Repeat.

240-1115-4247-5470.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability, giving Bloodthrone Vampire +2/+2 until end of turn
Repeat from step 2.

62-833-3756-3827.notablePrerequisites:
Soul of Windgrace can attack without taking damage.
Savage Ventmaw can attack without taking damage.
62-833-3756-3827.description:
Declare Savage Ventmaw and Soul of Windgrace as attackers.
When they attack, Savage Ventmaw and Soul of Windgrace trigger.
Resolve the Savage Ventmaw trigger, adding six mana that you will not lose this turn as steps and phases end.
Resolve the Soul of Windgrace trigger, returning Izzet Boilerworks from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Izzet Boilerworks enters, it triggers, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
In your next main phase, cast Waves of Aggression from your graveyard for its retrace cost by paying {3}{R/W}{R/W} and discarding Izzet Boilerworks, causing you to untap all creatures that attacked this turn, and to get an additional combat and main phase after this one.
Repeat.

4050-6566--5--195.notablePrerequisites: At least one persist creature has a +1/+1 counter on it.
4050-6566--5--195.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the persist creature that has a +1/+1 counter on it, adding one mana of any color.
When that creature dies, its persist ability and Yuna trigger.
Resolve Yuna's ability, putting at least two +1/+1 counters onto the surviving persist creature due to the counter-increasing effect.
If that creature had a -1/-1 counter on it, remove that and one of the +1/+1 counters from it as a state-based action.
Resolve the persist ability from step 2, returning the persist creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter.
Repeat.

997-5233-6871-7115--44.description:
Cast the artifact by paying {0}.
Toph, Hardheaded Teacher triggers, earthbending Boros Garrison.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Boros Garrison.
When Boros Garrison dies, Toph, Hardheaded Teach triggers, returning Boros Garrison from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Boros Garrison enters, it triggers, returning the artifact cast in step 1 from the battlefield to your hand, as it's a land due to Toph, the First Metalbender.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability
Repeat.

2034-3755-6968-6970-7850.description:
Cast Abby from the command zone by paying {1}{R}{G} plus commander tax if applicable.
Abby triggers, creating a number of 1/1 Fungus Zombie creature tokens named Cordyceps Infected equal to the amount of mana spent to cast it.
When Abby enters under an opponent's control, Mirror of Life Trapping triggers, exiling Abby.
Choose to return Abby from exile to the command zone.
Activate two Codryceps Infected tokens by tapping them, adding {R}{G}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a Cordyceps Infected token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat step 6 until you have enough mana to cast Abby.
Repeat from step 1.

5223-7686-7763.notablePrerequisites: You control four or more Squirrels.
5223-7686-7763.description:
Activate The Unbeatable Squirrel Girl by paying {1}{G}{G}{G}, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token for each Squirrel you control.
Activate four Squirrels by tapping them, adding {1}{G}{G}{G}.
Repeat
5223-7686-7763.notes: You'll create double as many Squirrels each loop. All Squirrels beyond the first four will be untapped and can be used to add additional mana.

5088-5148-5256-7443-7537.easyPrerequisites: You control at least three basic lands.
5088-5148-5256-7443-7537.notablePrerequisites:
You control eight or more lands.
Any one opponent cannot block and kill Emeritus of Abundance this turn.
5088-5148-5256-7443-7537.description:
Cast a copy of Regrowth from exile by paying {1}{G}, targeting any card besides the actual Regrowth.
Pyromancer's Ascension's first ability triggers, allowing you to put a quest counter on it.
Resolve the copy of Regrowth, returning that card from your graveyard to your hand.
Declare Emeritus of Abundance as an attacker.
When Emeritus of Abundance attacks, it triggers, becoming prepared.
During your second main phase, cast a copy of Regrowth by paying {1}{G}, targeting the actual Regrowth card.
Pyromancer Ascension's first ability triggers, allowing you to put a quest counter on it.
Resolve the copy of Regrowth, returning Regrowth from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Early Harvest by paying its mana cost.
Pyromancer Ascension's second ability triggers, copying Early Harvest.
Resolve a copy of Early Harvest, untapping basic lands you control.
Activate those lands by tapping them, adding mana.
Resolve the remaining copy of Early Harvest, untapping lands you control.
Activate those lands by tapping them, adding mana.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Emeritus of Abundance, producing that card's result.
Cast the card Regrowth from your hand by paying {1}{G}, targeting Emeritus of Abundance.
Pyromancer Ascension's second ability triggers, copying Regrowth and allowing you to target Early Harvest with the copy.
Resolve both copies of Regrowth, returning Emeritus of Abundance and Early Harvest from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Early Harvest by paying its mana cost.
Pyromancer Ascension's second ability triggers, copying Early Harvest.
Resolve a copy of Early Harvest, untapping lands you control.
Activate those lands by tapping them, adding mana.
Resolve the remaining copy of Early Harvest, untapping lands you control.
Activate those lands by tapping them, adding mana.
Cast Emeritus of Abundance by paying {2}{G}.
Cast a copy of Regrowth from exile by paying {1}{G}, targeting Early Harvest.
Both of Pyromancer Ascension's abilities trigger.
In response, activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Emeritus of Ideation, producing that card's result.
Resolve Pyromancer Ascension's first abiliity, putting a redundant quest counter on it if desired.
Resolve Pyromancer Ascension's second ability, copying Regrowth and targeting Emeritus of Abundance with the copy.
Repeat from step 18.

uses.n: Etali, Primal Conqueror // Etali, Primal Sickness

575-2921-4294-7115.description:
Cast Etali by paying {5}{R}{R}
When Etali enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Etali.
When Etali dies, Yedora triggers, returning Etali from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down as a Forest land.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Holding priority, activate Etali by tapping it, adding {G}.
Resolve the Etali trigger from step 2, exiling cards from the top of each library until each player has exiled a nonland card, and causing you to cast any number of those cards without paying its mana cost.
For each card cast, Toph's second ability triggers once.
Resolve the first Toph trigger, earthbending Etali.
Resolve any remaining triggers, earthbending any other lands you desire. If you do not want to earthbend other lands, target Etali with all remaining triggers.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Etali.
When Etali dies, Toph and Yedora trigger.
Resolve the Yedora trigger, choosing not to return Etali.
Resolve the Toph trigger, returning Etali from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Repeat from step 2.
Resolve all Bartolomé del Presidio abilities from step 11.

5614-7282-7340.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
5614-7282-7340.description:
Activate Bighorner Rancher by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}{G}{G}
Activate Chrome Dome by paying {5}, creating a token copy of Sewer-veillance Cam.
When the Sewer-veillance Cam token enters, it triggers, untapping Bighorner Rancher.
Repeat.

457-1329-5330-7340.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Sewer-veillance Cam from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Sewer-veillance Cam from your graveyard by paying {U}.
When Sewer-veillance Cam enters, it triggers, untapping Emry.
Activate Urza's first ability by tapping Sewer-veillance Cam, adding {U}.
Activate Atog by sacrificing Sewer-veillance Cam.
Sewer-veillance Cam triggers, untapping a creature you control.
Resolve the Atog ability.
Repeat.
457-1329-5330-7340.notes: If you control an artifact creature, it can be untapped by the second Sewer-veillance Cam trigger, and then tapped via Urza to get infinite blue mana. Once you have infinite blue mana, you can either use it for Urza's second ability and/or to activate Sewer-veillance Cam's ability to draw cards.

413-586-1472-5626.easyPrerequisites: You do not control a creature named Keimi.
413-586-1472-5626.description:
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {1}{B}.
Tatsunari triggers, creating a 3/3 Keimi legendary creature token.
When Keimi enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying {E}{E}{E}, sacrificing Keimi and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand, returning Priest of Gix from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Priest of Gix enters, it and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Priest of Gix trigger, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Priest of Gix.
Repeat.

1778-2981-5220-6900.description:
Activate Megatog by sacrificing Memnite
When Memnite dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Memnite from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Megatog ability.
Cast Memnite from the top of your library by paying 0 life.
Repeat.

2974-4872-6689.easyPrerequisites: You control four or more artifacts.
2974-4872-6689.description:
Cast Time Warp by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Repository Skaab by paying {3}{U}.
When Repository Skaab enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, causing it to exploit itself. Its second ability then triggers, returning Time Warp from your graveyard to your hand.
At the beginning of your end step, Golbez's second ability triggers, returning Repository Skaab from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

4484-4871-5256-5643-6709.easyPrerequisites:
A creature not named Ebondeath, Dracolich has died this turn.
You've cast a spell this turn.
Ballad of the Black Flag's fourth chapter ability has triggered this turn
4484-4871-5256-5643-6709.description:
Cast Ebondeath from your graveyard by paying {B}{B}.
Geralf's first ability triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie Rogue creature token.
When the Zombie Rogue enters the battlefield, Geralf's second ability triggers,  putting a number of +1/+1 counters on the Zombie Rogue equal to the number of other Zombies that entered the battlefield under your control.
When Ebondeath enters the battlefield, Geralf's second ability triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Ebondeath equal to the number of other Zombies that entered the battlefield under your control.
Activate Altar of Dementia twice by sacrificing the Zombie Rogue and Ebondeath.
When the Zombie Rogue and Ebondeath die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve both Altar of Dementia abilities.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Repeat.
4484-4871-5256-5643-6709.notes: This combo will steadily put more +1/+1 counters on Ebondeath and the Zombie Rogue token, eventually resulting in an infinite number of them.

2558-5330-5727-6705.description:
Cast Sword of the Meek by paying {2}.
When Sword of the Meek enters the battlefield, The Prydwen triggers.
Holding priority, activate Atog by sacrificing Sword of the Meek.
Resolve the Prydwen trigger, creating a 2/2 Human Knight and a 1/1 Frog creature token.
When the Frog enters the battlefield, Sword of the Meek triggers, returning Sword of the Meek from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the Soldier.
Repeat from step 2.

4484-4871-5147-6518.notablePrerequisites: A creature not named Ebondeath, Dracolich has died this turn.
4484-4871-5147-6518.description:
Cast Ebondeath from your graveyard by paying {B}{B}.
When Ebondeath enters, The Sibsig Ceremony triggers, destroying Ebondeath and creating a 2/2 Zombie Druid creature token.
When Ebondeath dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the Zombie Druid.
When the Zombie Druid dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Repeat.

549-2099-2267-3698.notablePrerequisites: You have at least two cards in your graveyard.
549-2099-2267-3698.description:
Activate Sarcatog's first ability by exiling two cards from your graveyard.
Tormod triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
When the Zombie enters the battlefield as an artifact due to Biotransference, Grinding Station triggers, untapping Grinding Station.
Resolve the Sarcatog ability, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn.
Activate Grinding Station by tapping it and sacrificing the Zombie, causing you to mill three cards.
Repeat.

478-907-2821-3664-3918.notablePrerequisites: Trazyn does not have summoning sickness.
478-907-2821-3664-3918.description:
Activate Lotus Field by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Selesnya Sanctuary by tapping it, adding {G}{W}.
Activate Trazyn by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Minamo, Lotus Field and Selesnya Sanctuary.
Activate Minamo's second ability by paying {U}, untapping Trazyn.
Repeat from step 3.

3705-4365-5231-5997.description:
Cast Squee from your graveyard or from exile by paying {1}{R}{R}.
Iraxxa triggers, creating two 2/2 Alien Warrior creature tokens.
Activate Thermopod's second ability three times by sacrificing Squee and the Alien Warriors, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Repeat.

413-1762-4871-5173-5626.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Shambling Ghast.
When Shambling Ghast dies, it, Pitiless Plunderer and Wilhelt's first ability trigger.
Resolve the Shambling Ghast and Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Wilhelt trigger, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token with decayed.
When the Zombie enters the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {1}{B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying {E}, sacrificing the Zombie token, and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand, returning Shambling Ghast from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Shambling Ghast enters the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Repeat.

3542-5778.notablePrerequisites: You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {5}{U}{U}.
3542-5778.description:
Activate up to seven lands by tapping them, adding at least {5}{U}{U}.
Cast Palinchron by paying {5}{U}{U} plus an additional {2} for its offspring cost.
When Palinchron enters the battlefield, it triggers twice.
Resolve the first Palinchron trigger, untapping up to seven lands.
Holding priority, activate up to seven lands by tapping them, adding at least {5}{U}{U}.
Resolve the second Palinchron trigger, creating a token copy of it that is 1/1.
When the Palinchron token enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to seven lands.
Activate the nontoken Palinchron by paying {2}{U}{U}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

2440-2714-4720-5105.description:
Cast Siege-Gang Commander by paying {3}{R}{R}.
When Siege-Gang Commander enters the battlefield, it and Mana Echoes trigger.
Resolve the Siege-Gang Commander trigger, creating three 1/1 Goblin creature tokens.
When the Goblin tokens enter the battlefield, Mana Echoes triggers three times.
Resolve all four Mana Echoes triggers, adding at least {16}.
Activate Stonework Packbeast four times by paying {8}, adding {W}{R}{R}{R}.
Activate Siege-Gang Commander by paying {C}{R} and sacrificing itself.
Sigil of the New Dawn triggers, causing you to pay {C}{W} to return Siege-Gang Commander from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Siege-Gang Commander activated ability, dealing 2 damage to any target.
Repeat.

914-1170-3148-5078.notablePrerequisites: Opponents control at least five artifacts and/or enchantments.
914-1170-3148-5078.description:
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {1}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Dockside Extortionist.
When Dockside Extortionist enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating at least five Treasure artifact tokens.
Activate five Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {5}.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top from the battlefield on top of your library.
Activate Thrasios by paying {4}, causing you to scry 1, ensuring to leave Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library, and then drawing Sensei's Divining Top from your library.
Repeat.
If opponents control at least six artifacts and/or enchantments, this combo nets near-infinite Treasure tokens.

49-1173-1984-3454.manaNeeded: {2}{R}{W} the first turn, with {10}{R}{R}{W}{W} available each extra turn
49-1173-1984-3454.notablePrerequisites: Sunforger attached to a creature you control.
49-1173-1984-3454.description:
Activate Sunforger by paying {R}{W} and unattaching it, searching your library for Final Fortune and casting it without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Final Fortune, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Soldevi Digger by paying {2}, putting Final Fortune on the bottom of your library from your graveyard.
Move to your next turn.
Activate Sunforger's equip ability by paying {3}, attaching it to a creature you control.
Repeat steps 1 through 3 one additional time.
Activate Sunforger's equip ability by paying {3}, attaching it to a creature you control.
Activate Sunforger by paying {R}{W} and unattaching it, searching your library for Angel's Grace and casting it without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Angel's Grace, preventing you from losing the game this turn.
Activate Soldevi Digger by paying {2}, putting Angel's Grace on the bottom of your library from your graveyard.
At the beginning of your end step, Final Fortune triggers, however you cannot lose the game due to Angel's Grace.
Repeat from step 4.

789-2946-4050.notablePrerequisites: A non-Skeleton creature has died under your control this turn.
789-2946-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Cult Conscript, adding {B}.
When Cult Conscript dies, Gutter Grime triggers, putting a slime counter on it and creating an Ooze creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Ooze, adding {1}.
Activate Cult Conscript by paying {1}{B}, return it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.
789-2946-4050.notes: This combo also puts infinite slime counters on Gutter Grime, allowing you to easily create additional infinitely large creature tokens.

1824-2452.notablePrerequisites: You have not completed Tomb of Annihilation.
1824-2452.description:
Cast Acererak by paying {0}.
Acererak enters the battlefield, returning it to your hand and venturing into the Lost Mine of Phandelver.
Each time you trigger the Dark Pool room ability, each opponent loses one life and you gain 1 life.
Repeat.

422-1050-2636-3263.description:
Mycosynth Lattice makes eveything an atrifact, Darksteel Forge makes all of your artifacts indestructible.
Nevinyrrall's Disk destroyes all artifacts except yours because yours are indestructable.
Unwinding Clock allows this to happen every untap step.

864-3617-4305.notablePrerequisites: Followed Footsteps attached to Eternal Witness.
864-3617-4305.description:
Cast Time Walk by paying {1}{U}, taking an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Followed Footsteps triggers, creating a copy of Eternal Witness.
Eternal Witness enters the battlefield, returning Time Walk from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.n: Ojer Taq, Deepest Foundation // Temple of Civilization
